svg.metadata: Editable vector reconstruction of the 1672 × 941 reference: dynamic geothermal-source boundary and cross-scale transmission. All Chinese labels are native text. Reservoir temperature range (150–300°C) is transcribed from the reference. Stratigraphic textures, mountains, heat-pump machinery and user-side buildings are vector approximations of photographic details. No embedded raster.
